tokens.name: --background
tokens.description: The app canvas: behind cards, the springboard, the launch screen. Opaque.

tokens.name: --foreground
tokens.description: Primary ink: headings, a row's own name, key figures. Also the SDK shell tooltip text.

tokens.name: --card
tokens.description: Panel surface, one step off the canvas (in dark mode lighter, never darker). Read by anything that needs the card colour without the Card frame. Opaque.

tokens.name: --card-foreground
tokens.description: Ink on `--card` and `--card-bg`. Usually equal to `--foreground`.

tokens.name: --popover
tokens.description: Overlay surface: menus, popovers, selects, dialogs, sheets, toasts, the inbox. Opaque.

tokens.name: --popover-foreground
tokens.description: Ink on `--popover`.

tokens.name: --muted
tokens.description: Quiet fill: neutral count badges, skeleton bars, the progress-ring track, the SDK shell tooltip box.

tokens.name: --muted-foreground
tokens.description: Tertiary ink: metadata, captions, timestamps, placeholders.

tokens.name: --accent
tokens.description: Highlight fill (shadcn meaning, not a brand accent): menu-item highlight, ghost and icon-button hover.

tokens.name: --accent-foreground
tokens.description: Ink on `--accent`.

tokens.name: --secondary
tokens.description: Secondary button fill (shadcn `secondary`). May equal `--card` for an outlined style; see `--button-secondary-border`.

tokens.name: --secondary-foreground
tokens.description: Label on `--secondary`.

tokens.name: --field
tokens.description: Fill of inputs, selects, comboboxes, textareas, the Ask composer, segmented tracks. Opaque.

tokens.name: --field-border
tokens.description: Resting edge of every field and of unchecked checkboxes and radios.

tokens.name: --row-hover
tokens.description: Hover fill of rows and tiles. May be translucent; composited over the surface below.

tokens.name: --row-selected
tokens.description: Selected row. Neutral by default: the state is carried by a checked box or `aria-selected`, not by this tint.

tokens.name: --segment-track
tokens.description: The track a segmented control sits in: a control surface, usually `--field`.

tokens.name: --segment-selected
tokens.description: Fill of the selected segment; the SDK phone kit's selected segment reads it. One surface step off the track; its label is `--foreground`.

tokens.name: --btn-surface
tokens.description: The secondary button fill under the reference app's name. Equal to `--secondary`.

tokens.name: --btn-surface-hover
tokens.description: Secondary button fill on hover: the fill moves, not the edge.

tokens.name: --dim-foreground
tokens.description: Secondary ink: body copy, table cells, field labels, descriptions.

tokens.name: --subtle-foreground
tokens.description: Quiet ink with a job: eyebrows, units, deliberately quiet figures. The floor for readable text.

tokens.name: --disabled-foreground
tokens.description: Inactive controls and their labels only (WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive UI).

tokens.name: --inverse-foreground
tokens.description: Text and glyphs on `--brand` and `--brand-hover` fills.

tokens.name: --border-subtle
tokens.description: Structure only: card edges, dividers, header rules, the rail and top-bar frame. Under 3:1 is allowed, so nothing interactive or stateful is drawn with it alone.

tokens.name: --border
tokens.description: Interactive edges: outlined buttons, chips, toggles, the segmented strip (the canon's meaning, reference-app `src/index.css:270-277`; shadcn's structural uses re-point to the component tokens below).

tokens.name: --border-strong
tokens.description: Hover and pressed edges; an emphasis rule.

tokens.name: --input
tokens.description: shadcn's input-border name (web-app inputs read `border-input`).

tokens.name: --ring
tokens.description: shadcn and SDK-shell name for the focus ring (`shell.css:40`).

tokens.name: --primary
tokens.description: shadcn primary: default button fill in shadcn components and the checked fill of checkboxes, radios, switches, sliders, progress bars. It marks state, so it must stand off the page. The one prime action per view reads `--button-primary-bg`, which may differ.

tokens.name: --primary-foreground
tokens.description: Label and check glyph on `--primary`.

tokens.name: --brand
tokens.description: The direction's signature colour as a mark: progress fill, selected-tab underline, the launch progress bar, the wordmark colour version. Not a text colour (use `--link`).

tokens.name: --brand-hover

tokens.name: --brand-subtle
tokens.description: Brand tint for quiet emphasis: the "New" and "Updated" marks. May be translucent.

tokens.name: --link
tokens.description: Text-safe brand: links, text actions that navigate, the caret, and the SDK shell's link (through `--info`).

tokens.name: --destructive

tokens.name: --destructive-foreground
tokens.description: Label on `--destructive`.

tokens.name: --status-info
tokens.description: The info ink: the info chip's word, an info callout's text. The reference's `var(--link)` (`src/index.css:400, 671`), and still `--link`'s value in light; its own token since decision 64 (20 Nov), one step lighter than `--link` in dark so the word holds 4.5:1 on `--status-info-bg` on a selected row. tokens.name: --status-info-line
tokens.description: Info edge, decorative (reference-app `src/index.css:402, 673`). The reference retired info as a status (`:379-399`: blue is links, focus and the primary action); its ink and tint are `--status-info` and `--status-info-bg`.

tokens.name: --status-info-series
tokens.description: Info as a chart mark (a chart's info series). `--brand` in light, as the chart drew it; one step lighter than `--brand` in dark (decision 64, 20 Nov) so a line holds 3:1 on a selected row while `--brand` stays the buttons' fill.

tokens.name: --status-check

tokens.name: --status-check-line
tokens.description: Decorative edge of a check callout.
